title: Git CLI Basics
summary: Learn the smallest Git commands that reveal repository state.

modules.title: Repository State
modules.summary: Initialize and inspect a temporary Git repository.

lessons.title: Initialize And Check Status
lessons.concept_md: `git init` creates a repository. `git status --short` gives compact feedback for scripts and automation.
lessons.prompt: Initialize a Git repo, create `note.txt`, and print short status.
lessons.starter_code:
git init
printf 'hello\n' > note.txt
git status --short
lessons.hidden_hint: The expected output should include `?? note.txt`.

lessons.title: Stage A File
lessons.concept_md: `git add` moves a file into the staging area. `git status --short` shows staged files with `A` in the first column.
lessons.prompt: Initialize a repo, create `note.txt`, stage it, and print short status.
lessons.starter_code:
git init
printf 'hello\n' > note.txt
git status --short

lessons.title: Make A First Commit
lessons.concept_md: A commit records staged changes. Local scripts can set a throwaway identity before committing in a temporary repo.
lessons.prompt: Create a repo, commit `note.txt`, and print the commit subject.
lessons.starter_code:
git init
git config user.email learner@example.local
git config user.name Learner
printf 'hello\n' > note.txt
git add note.txt
git commit -m 'Add note'
git log --oneline -1
lessons.hidden_hint: The log output should include the commit message.

lessons.title: Create A Branch
lessons.concept_md: Branches are movable names for lines of work. `git branch --show-current` prints the active branch name.
lessons.prompt: Create a repo, make a first commit, create `feature/docs`, and print the current branch.
lessons.starter_code:
git init
git config user.email learner@example.local
git config user.name Learner
printf 'hello\n' > note.txt
git add note.txt
git commit -m 'Add note'
git branch --show-current
lessons.hidden_hint: Create and switch branches with `git checkout -b feature/docs` before printing the current branch.
